The same designed runs, rush attempts that are neither scrambles, kneel-downs nor two-point tries (since 0.54.0); equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, pairs designed_carries and rush_success_count).
There over every carry (scrambles and kneel-downs too; explosive at 10 yards, stuffs without kneel-downs); here over designed runs, explosive at 12 yards (kept on purpose in phase 1, DECISIONS.md).
There completions of 20 or more yards per dropback; here dropbacks gaining 20 or more.
There over every scrimmage snap; here over dropbacks and carries.
There a snap without a down (a two-point try) is an early down and two-point passes are dropbacks (PARITY.md, causes null_downs and two_point_tries).
The same flags read on every play, an attempt counted once (since 0.54.0); equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, the third-down, fourth-down and two-point pairs).
There first downs by penalty count too; here passing plus rushing first downs (PARITY.md, cause penalty_first_downs, kept).

There fumbles on scrimmage snaps, a lost one charged to the team that fumbled; here fumbles on plays that are not special-teams plays, a lost one charged to the team with the ball (PARITY.md, cause fumbles_on_scrimmage_snaps, kept).
The same counts, Jacksonville's 2001-2002 home games repaired here too (since 0.54.0); equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, pairs penalties and penalty_yards).
